queries: OpenAI "Why language models hallucinate" hallucinations remain a fundamental challenge

sources_considered.why: Primary statement by a leading LLM developer on hallucinations in its newest model.

receipt.public_excerpt: GPT‑5 has significantly fewer hallucinations especially when reasoning⁠, but they still occur. Hallucinations remain a fundamental challenge for all large language models, but we are working hard to further reduce them.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI itself says hallucinations still occur in GPT-5 and remain a fundamental challenge for all LLMs. That supports 'no robust solution'.

receipt.public_excerpt: Even as language models become more capable, one challenge remains stubbornly hard to fully solve: hallucinations.

evidence_items.explanation: The developer describes hallucinations as stubbornly hard to fully solve. That supports the claim.

unresolved_gaps: Hallucination rates have fallen (OpenAI notes GPT-5 has significantly fewer). The claim concerns a robust solution, not progress.
